jobs.title: Director of Demand Generation
jobs.description: Job opportunity: Director of Demand Generation All Jobs Marketing Director of Demand Generation IONIX is a pioneer in EASM, an emerging area in cybersecurity dedicated to helping organizations uncover vulnerabilities in their external attack surface. We’re looking for creative innovators who share our passion for protecting the world from the risks inherent in hyperconnected online attack surfaces. US, EST or TOLA (Remote) About The Position About IONIX IONIX External Exposure Management protects enterprises’ external attack surface from cyber risks and increases security team efficiency by providing tools that shorten the time to discover and prioritize exposures. IONIX reduces the exploitable attack surface by discovering every internet-facing asset, assessing dependencies and connections, and validating exploitable risks to prioritize remediation of critical, impactful exposures. IONIX reduces alert fatigue, streamlines the process for resolving alerts and ensures that they reach the right team. Global leaders including BlackRock, Infosys, Sompo, The Telegraph and E.ON depend on IONIX for proactive management of their complex and dynamic attack surface. About The Role You own demand generation end to end: strategy, execution, and pipeline number. You build and run the programs that turn IONIX's category position into qualified pipeline for the sales team, across ABM, paid digital, and email. You manage budget, set targets, and report pipeline contribution to the executive team. This is a builder role with a number attached. You will scale programs, hire, and answer for sourced and influenced pipeline. Responsibilities Pipeline target. Own marketing-sourced and marketing-influenced pipeline. Set the targets, hit them, and report contribution against bookings. Account-based marketing. Run the ABM program against Tier 1 and Tier 2 target accounts. Coordinate plays across paid, email, and sales outreach so marketing and the field hit the same accounts with the same message at the same time. Digital advertising. Own paid acquisition across LinkedIn, Meta, and Reddit. Manage spend, creative testing, audience targeting, and CAC. Drive efficient pipeline, not vanity metrics. Email marketing. Own lifecycle and nurture programs. Build segmented, persona-aware campaigns that move contacts from first touch to sales-ready. Funnel and attribution. Own the reporting that ties every program to pipeline. Run the marketing tech stack (CRM, marketing automation, attribution) and make the numbers defensible. Requirements 8+ years in B2B demand generation, with 3+ years leading the function. Director level or above. Cybersecurity experience.You have sold security to security buyers and you know how this audience evaluates vendors. You understand the difference between a CISO, a VM leader, and an attack surface owner, and you message to each. Proven ABM track record against named enterprise accounts, with results measured in pipeline and closed revenue. Hands-on command of paid social, specifically LinkedIn, Meta, and Reddit. You have run the campaigns, read the data, and reallocated spend. Email and lifecycle marketing depth: segmentation, nurture design, deliverability, and conversion. Fluency in the modern marketing stack: Clay, HubSpot, Salesforce and how everything ties together. A number you can point to. You ran the program, you owned the pipeline target, you hit it. Bonus Points Experience marketing to enterprise security teams at $500M+ organisations. Familiarity with the attack surface management, exposure management, or CTEM categories. Track record building a demand gen function from an early stage and scaling it. Apply for this position

jobs.title: Security Researcher
jobs.description: Job opportunity: Security Researcher All Jobs Research Security Researcher IONIX is a pioneer in EASM, an emerging area in cybersecurity dedicated to helping organizations uncover vulnerabilities in their external attack surface. We’re looking for creative innovators who share our passion for protecting the world from the risks inherent in hyperconnected online attack surfaces. Israel, Tel Aviv About The Position IONIX is redefining how the world's largest enterprises manage their external attack surface. Our External Exposure Management platform empowers security teams to discover every internet-facing asset, map dependencies, validate exploitable risks, and prioritize what truly matters - at scale, in real time. Global leaders including BlackRock, Warnet Music Group, Infosys, Sompo, The Telegraph, and E.ON trust IONIX to proactively defend their complex and dynamic attack surfaces. We reduce alert fatigue, streamline remediation workflows, and ensure critical risks reach the right people - fast. As a Security Researcher, you will play a crucial role in researching, building, and enhancing our cutting-edge technology to address the evolving cybersecurity challenges faced by the world's largest enterprises. Responsibilities Research, develop, and implement new offensive security capabilities that push the boundaries of the EASM category, including exploit development and PoC creation across web applications, AI/LLM assets, network infrastructure, cloud environments, and supply chain dependencies. Drive innovation by conceptualizing, implementing, and adopting AI-driven initiatives and offensive security expertise to enhance IONIX's detection, validation, and automation capabilities at scale. Conduct in-depth research to continuously expand platform coverage. Develop exploitability tests to uncover critical, real-world findings across enterprise attack surfaces - directly demonstrating the power of the IONIX platform. Collaborate with global enterprises as design partners to understand their security needs and design solutions accordingly. Take ownership of key research projects, addressing security and scalability challenges from concept through to delivery. Requirements 5+ years of hands-on experience in security research, offensive security. Practical experience conducting offensive security assessments, including web application exploitation, network-based attacks, and adversarial attack simulation. Strong development skills (Python - advantage): capable of writing production-quality, scalable code. Advantages: Prior published CVEs, conference talks, or public security research is a strong plus. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience is preferred. Experience with leveraging emerging LLMs and AI capabilities. Apply for this position

jobs.title: Director of Customer Success
jobs.description: Job opportunity: Director of Customer Success All Jobs Sales Director of Customer Success IONIX is a pioneer in EASM, an emerging area in cybersecurity dedicated to helping organizations uncover vulnerabilities in their external attack surface. We’re looking for creative innovators who share our passion for protecting the world from the risks inherent in hyperconnected online attack surfaces. Full-time US East Coast About The Position About IONIX IONIX External Exposure Management protects enterprises’ external attack surface from cyber risks and increases security team efficiency by helping organizations discover, prioritize, and remediate their most impactful exposures. IONIX continuously discovers internet-facing assets, understands their dependencies and connections, and validates exploitable risks so security teams can focus on what matters most. Global enterprises including BlackRock, Infosys, Sompo, The Telegraph, and E.ON rely on IONIX to proactively manage their complex and dynamic attack surfaces. About the Position IONIX is looking for a Director of Technical Customer Success to lead our Customer Success team and customer activities in the US. This is a hands-on leadership role combining people management, technical customer engagement, operational ownership, and direct responsibility for several of IONIX's strategic enterprise customers. The Director will serve as the senior Customer Success focal point during US business hours, supporting and coaching the US CSM team, overseeing customer health and escalations, and ensuring consistent execution of IONIX's Customer Success methodology across the region. You will work closely with the VP of Customer Success in Israel, as well as Sales, Support, Product, and R&D, to ensure customers successfully adopt IONIX, achieve measurable security outcomes, and receive a consistently high level of service. The position will initially begin with a significant hands-on CSM component , allowing you to master the IONIX platform, our customers, and our Customer Success practices. As you ramp up, the role will progressively shift toward team leadership and operational responsibilities while maintaining ownership of a select number of strategic customers. What Success Looks Like Success in this role means the US Customer Success organization operates with clear ownership and visibility: CSMs are supported and continuously developing, customer status is well understood and documented, risks are identified early, escalations are handled effectively, and customers are consistently realizing measurable value from IONIX. Over time, you will transition from being primarily a hands-on CSM to leading and scaling the US Customer Success operation, while remaining close enough to strategic customers and the technology to stay deeply connected to both. Responsibilities Lead and develop the US Customer Success team , providing day-to-day guidance, coaching, prioritization, and support. Serve as the senior CS focal point during US hours for customer issues, escalations, and cross-functional coordination. Own several strategic enterprise customers , building strong relationships from technical stakeholders through executive and CISO level. Maintain visibility into the health, risks, objectives, adoption, and key activities of US customers and regularly report status, trends, and areas requiring attention. Proactively identify customers at risk , develop recovery plans, and work with CSMs and internal stakeholders to de-escalate issues and improve customer health. Lead and support customer escalations , ensuring clear ownership, communication, action plans, and follow-through. Ensure consistent execution of Customer Success processes across onboarding, adoption, ongoing engagement, executive reviews, renewals, and customer risk management. Continuously evaluate existing processes, identify gaps, and define and implement scalable CS practices as the organization grows. Ensure customer knowledge, decisions, risks, action items, and account status are accurately documented and maintained by the team. Partner closely with the US Sales organization , maintaining alignment on customer status, renewals, expansion opportunities, risks, and strategic account activities. Collaborate with Product, Support, R&D, and other teams to represent customer needs and drive resolution of issues impacting customer success. Develop the team's technical and product expertise and ensure CSMs can confidently guide customers on operationalizing IONIX, integrations, workflows, and security best practices. Requirements 7+ years of experience in technical customer-facing roles, including significant experience in Customer Success with enterprise customers. Previous people management or team leadership experience , with a demonstrated ability to coach, develop, and hold team members accountable. Previous hands-on experience in a technical role such as Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Technical Support, Security Engineering, or similar before moving into Customer Success. Experience working for a cybersecurity vendor and strong understanding of security organizations, stakeholders, and workflows. Experience managing large, complex enterprise customers , including technical and executive-level relationships. Strong technical understanding of core web and cloud technologies, including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, HTML, PKI, web applications, and cloud environments . Strong understanding of web security concepts, vulnerabilities, and security technologies . Proven ability to manage customer escalations, identify account risk, and drive structured recovery plans. Strong operational and process orientation, with experience building, improving, and enforcing scalable processes across a team. Excellent organizational skills and attention to documentation, customer status, commitments, and follow-through.
